title: IN WHICH THE RED SEA AND THE INDIAN OCEAN PROVE PROPITIOUS TO THE DESIGNS OF PHILEAS FOGG
summary_hover: Phileas Fogg and Passepartout travel aboard the Mongolia to Bombay, where Fogg plays whist and Fix subtly befriends Passepartout.
summary_detail: Aboard the steamer Mongolia, Phileas Fogg remains indifferent to the sights of the Red Sea and Indian Ocean, occupying himself entirely with playing whist. Meanwhile, Detective Fix subtly befriends Passepartout to glean information without revealing his true identity. The ship makes excellent time, and Fogg arrives in Bombay two days ahead of schedule.
